name: Ibuki
source:
Likes: Drinks, Women, Nature
Dislikes: Cowards
Hobby: Walking, Napping, Shopping
Home: Spring Village

Gentle yet wild gunman with mature charms.

Ibuki is previously the candidate for the Spring Village chieftain. His ancestor is Soma, the Wind Village ninja.
However, his personality is thought to be similar to the one of Noritsune, the brother of Soma.

He has been working on restoring the beauty of Hokuto Island.
Words can't describe how badly damaged the island currently is.
Ibuki's passion touches you so deeply that you help him save Hokuto Island.

He is easy to get along with. Including his brother, Yayoi, he is respected by everyone he knows.

[From in-game profile]
